name: @ragenai/rag-core
description: Vector-store contract shared by apps/web, apps/api and apps/worker (ADR-26)
//exports: Two entry points, because one consumer runs in a sandbox. The root barrel loads `vector-contract`, which reads `process.env` at module scope, and a Temporal workflow bundle has no `process` — importing the barrel from `apps/worker/src/handlers/` fails every workflow task with `process is not defined`. `./undecodable-text` and `./document-diagnostics` import nothing and read no environment, which is what makes them safe to say so here.
